title: picture/status/v1
description: The authority's extras of console/status/v1 (uspace-lab schemas/common/console/status/v1, M29), the status frame picture-ws sends on connect, after every subscription and every 2 s. A frame validates against the lab's console/status/v1 and against this schema; this repository defines only what the lab leaves to the producing system (M14): the values of dp_state and nats, the degraded slugs, and since when each holds (nats_since, degraded_since). projection_age_s (the registry projection, database clock), cis_version and cis_age_s (the restrictions projection of the CIS cache) are absent while never projected, and say so in degraded. The thresholds (stale_after_s, live_max_age_s) are the active authority_policy's (INV-03). Each source in sources[] is source/status/v1's body with the adapters' lagging and lag_s.

slug.description: What is degraded. Global: nats_unavailable (the bus is lost: nothing leaves the picture, every aircraft ages), projections_unreadable, registry_projection_absent, cis_absent, cis_stale (older than the policy's cis_stale_bound_s), dp_unavailable (no Display Provider view: provider tracks are missing), alerts_unconfirmed (an active violation detect stopped republishing), alerts_replaying (the read-back of ALRT at start or after the bus came back), session_verifier_unavailable, source_control_unknown (B-09: every source enabled until the switches are read), policy_default (the documented defaults, policy version 0), tracks_evicted (the track cache is at its bound). Per connection: no_subscription, viewport_too_large (the previous viewport is kept), session_unchecked (the session could not be re-checked; the connection closes past the grace).

degraded_since.description: For every slug in degraded, since when it holds (this process's clock).

dp_state.description: The F3411 Display Provider (network_rid) as the source rows say: polling (an instance live), stale (heard, none live), disabled (the type switched off), unavailable (never heard; until WP-14 always).
